text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …My first dream of the year was about Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: After performing as well as her in my races, I was selected as Best Junior Year Umamusume—just like her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Then we trained together, and I went on to the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I had the same dream again… Hm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wonder if it's a premonition? Maybe I really will be selected as Best Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Chiyono O. And I apologize for not being able to watch you at the Asahi Hai F.S. the other day…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan! Happy New Year! Are you feeling better?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am. Thank you for asking. I'm prepared to put my all into training, starting today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's wonderful to hear! There's so much I want to talk to you abou—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt… Bzzt…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ack! Th-that's my phone! I'm so sorry about this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Could you have chosen a worse time to call, Big Bro? I'll call you back later, so—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …That's everyone who received an URA award this year. The Best Junior Umamusume award went to a racer who set a record in a junior 1,600-meter race…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: With an incredible 127 votes, there's no doubt she deserved the honor… But it wasn't me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The comment they left for me says, "She's definitely strong, but she's missing that special something to make her stand out"…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh well… I guess I didn't make it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's okay, though. There were still people who voted for you, were there not?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yeah, and I'm incredibly thankful for that, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I feel like the fact that I'm average has just been shoved in my face again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm always praised for being a hard worker, and I usually get threes and fours out of five on my report cards… which isn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But that's all I am—"not bad." I never exceed people's expectations or fall short of them. For better or worse, I'm just average.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Looking at that Umamusume who got over 120 votes… it kinda hits me that I'll never become a prodigy like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But even if I'm just average, that doesn't mean I'm going to give up on my dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If my opponent is a prodigy who can win the lottery after playing once, then I'll simply enter it a hundred times before she can do so.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maybe by doing that, I'll be able to win the grand prize before she gets a chance to try her luck!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Ardan, but please excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To win the Derby, the only thing a mediocre Umamusume like me can do is not give up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …She's just like me. We're both trying to overcome who we are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clatter, clatter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's New Year's, but I'm busying myself creating next week's training schedule. As I work away, Sakura Chiyono O comes flying through the door.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Can we start training earlier than planned?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Just tell me what I need to improve on, and I'll get started right away!
choice_data_list: The ability to predict how a race will develop.
Why don't you try exploring a new side of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm. Okay! Let's hurry and get ready to go, then!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To observe some races, of course! Um, let's see… The next high-profile race is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I can get a word in edgeways, Sakura Chiyono O starts making preparations…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And we end up at Kyoto Racecourse to watch a race.
choice_data_list: You sure know how to make things happen…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That just shows you how motivated I am!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now please concentrate on the race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Coming up from behind is Tamamo Cross! She's shot right up to the front in an instant! What powerful legs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oooh! So that's what an end closer is like! I see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Sakura Chiyono O and I continue to watch races for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Awww… Rest?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll loaf about on the floor, then. Is that all right with you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well, here I go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Sakura Chiyono O curls up on the big heated rug in my office.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's talk about my next race!
choice_data_list: I said you needed to rest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I am resting! I'm lying down and just chatting with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please! Just tell me about my next race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sudden rebellious attitude notwithstanding, Sakura Chiyono O relaxes in my office for a while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Explore a new side of me? In other words…

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Well, well. I wasn't expecting Miss Goody Two-Shoes to ask me for help.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Let's see if you can pass my test first. Go ahead and ask me to make you a real delinquent.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Er, okay. Um… Pl-please make me a real…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eek! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I frantically stop Sakura Chiyono O before she goes barreling down the wrong path in life.
